seo.title: Claim triage
seo.seo_description: Claim triage: a WorkStudio starter template for small business. Starting fields, steps, human approval and what to adapt for Quebec before use.

blocks.role: Promesse de la fiche : ce que fait le gabarit « Tri des déclarations de sinistre », dit sans détour.

translation.headline: Claim triage.
translation.subheadline: The Claim triage template classifies a claim report (category, urgency, summary, date, missing documents, points of attention), then writes the reply to the policyholder: acknowledgement and list of documents to provide.

blocks.role: Réponse d'abord : ce que fait le gabarit, en trois lignes.

translation.title: The short answer.
translation.body:
The Claim triage template classifies a claim report (category, urgency, summary, date, missing documents, points of attention), then writes the reply to the policyholder: acknowledgement and list of documents to provide. It announces no coverage, no amount and no compensation deadline.

A workflow template is an automated sequence of tasks, provided as a starting point in WorkStudio and to be adapted to the business before it is deployed.

blocks.role: Les champs de départ du gabarit, tels que déclarés dans WorkStudio.

translation.title: What you provide.
translation.body:
Each starting field is pre-filled with an example value so a first run needs no typing, except email addresses and files.

  • The report. Text of the claim report received.
  • The coverage. Policy coverage and deductibles, if you have them.

blocks.role: Les étapes du flux : ce que fait chaque agent, où une personne intervient.

cards.title: Classify the report.
cards.text: An agent answers in JSON: category (water damage, fire, theft, glass breakage, car collision, liability or other), urgency, summary, date, missing documents and points of attention.

cards.title: Reply to the policyholder.
cards.text: A second agent acknowledges receipt, restates the claim, requests the missing documents as a list and states what follows.

cards.title: Review.
cards.text: You read the text produced, correct it if needed, then use or send it yourself: the template sends nothing.

blocks.role: Ce qui s'adapte avant l'usage : le propre du gabarit, le commun, l'envoi.

cards.title: What to adapt here.
cards.text: The claim categories and the urgency rule are the template's: adapt them to your products and to the reporting deadlines that apply to you. The text is reviewed before sending.

cards.title: What applies to all.
cards.text: The templates are written for a French small business. Taxes, currency, vocabulary and formats are adapted to your business and to Quebec before any use.

cards.title: Nothing is sent.
cards.text: The template produces text to review. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

blocks.role: Questions de la fiche : envoi, point propre au gabarit, adaptation au Québec.

items.question: Does this template send anything for me?
items.answer: No. It produces text to review; you use or send it yourself. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

items.question: Does the template decide on compensation?
items.answer: No. It triages and drafts an acknowledgement. The reply announces no coverage, amount or deadline.

items.question: Does it suit Quebec as is?
items.answer: Not as is. The starter templates are written for a French small business and do not follow Quebec tax rules: taxes, formats and vocabulary are adapted to your business.
